what.question: What is Next Excalidraw?
what.answer: A SaaS platform that transforms text prompts into visual presentations using Excalidraw-style diagrams powered by AI.

design.question: Do I need design skills?
design.answer: No. Just describe what you want to present and the AI handles the visual structure for you.

edit.question: Can I edit the generated slides?
edit.answer: Yes. Every slide is fully editable on the Excalidraw canvas after generation.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes, 14 days free with no credit card required.
